message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to weather data, so I can’t give you the current conditions in London right now. If you’d like, I can point you toward some reliable sources where you can check the latest forecast:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **BBC Weather** | Visit [bbc.co.uk/weather](https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather) and search for “London”. |
| **Met Office** | Go to [metoffice.gov.uk](https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/) and look up London. |
| **Weather.com** | Open [weather.com](https://weather.com/) and type “London” in the search bar. |
| **AccuWeather** | Navigate to [accuweather.com](https://www.accuweather.com/) and search for London. |
| **OpenWeatherMap API** | If you’re a developer, you can use the OpenWeatherMap API (you’ll need an API key). |

If you need a quick snapshot, you can also ask a smart assistant on your phone (Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa) or check a weather widget on your device. Let me know if you’d like help with anything else!
